text: A tiered aluminium rack holds two rows of plastic dispensing bottles, photographed at an angle receding to the right. The upper row has seven tall white bottles with red pump dispensers, all fitted and upright; their collars are coloured green, blue, white, red, white, yellow and yellow-white. The lower front row has smaller squeeze bottles with white or clear caps in place, upright, each holding coloured liquid: yellow, dark brown/black, teal-green, black, and pale grey/white further right. Purple-and-white labels with pictograms and Chinese/English text ("Si-Pigment Brown", "Si-Pigment Green", "Si-Pigment Black", "Mold 1") are clipped to the rails. A white sign above reads "Material Storage Area".
